text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Christmas.
Invited by Viblos's family—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was attending a private, family-only party
at the villa they owned.
choice_data_list: Excuse me, are any of your family members...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, I was the one who invited you.
If anything, thank you for coming, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
We usually go all out for Christmas every year,
but this year we kept it modest, just as Vivlos asked!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
It's not much, but I've prepared
some food for you!
Please help yourself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look at the dishes laid out before us.
A large turkey, a heaping salad, a huge pot
of soup, and buffet-style small plates—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, umm... It's not much, but...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I mean...
Big Sis, why are you in your school uniform?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I have academy business to attend to
after this."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm preparing for the next race.
I have to get my revenge myself, after all."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...I need to do my training too."

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone's got a lot to do...
Should we wrap things up before it gets dark?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos loves her family and was so happy
when everyone could get together.
I worry she might feel lonely—
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, where is Vivlos?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Happy holidays♪
Happy, happy holidays~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the room goes pitch dark.
Then, accompanied by Viblos's singing,
a faint light draws closer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When the lights came on, a somewhat clumsy Christmas cake was sitting on the table. Arranged atop the pure white cream were—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
These doll-like things...
Could they be... us...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The biggest one is Papa, the second is Cheval-chi,
the third is Big Sis, and the fourth is Mama!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: And the little one in the middle is me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Of course, for you, Trainy!
I call it the 'I Love You Cake'!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You made this?
All of it, by yourself...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I asked a friend for the recipe—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I did all the rest by myself!
Even if I messed up a few times along the way, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You know... it just really hit me.
I just love everyone so much!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: If you have lots of fond memories, you won't feel lonely even when we're apart, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I was just hoping today would be that kind of day!
So I'm totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I'm always with everyone♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, Vivlos-chan.
You've reaaally grown so big, haven't you~

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
I know it's selfish, I know it's super selfish of me!
But I still feel lonely...!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Keep on begging and being selfish as much as you want!
Vivlos~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Papa, really.
Watching Vivlos grow up..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister...!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Well... I get it, but still.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Jeez, what's with everyone?! Nothing about me has changed at all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It just means there are more people
I can be needy and selfish with!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"So it's totally fine!
Right, Trainy? ♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You'll always be by my side, right, Trainie?
We're Trainer and Umamusume, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So don't worry, everyone♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-What is this feeling...?
Even though I feel safe and relieved...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
...I'll be in your care...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the lively family-only Christmas party continued on—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—See ya later,
everyooone!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haaah,
that was so much fun ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, of course I'm sad!
I wanted to be with you longer, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Told ya so!
I said it'd be fine since Trainy is with me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, we still have time, right?
Let's hang out a little more!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here,
I wanna party like a total celeb!"
choice_data_list: I thought today wasn't supposed to be "small-scale"?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hmm, looks like I changed my mind after all♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You know,
there's this new trend among celebrities!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Is this what they call an ugly sweater?
I got one for you too, Trainy, so let's wear them together ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Kyahahaha!
Trainy, you're totally a tree!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I had a wonderful time
hanging out with Vivlos until the evening.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, since we're here,
let's go out somewhere!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, transferring between cars and trains from the villa,
where we headed was...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa,
things are really heating up~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie!
The Christmas market is open!
choice_data_list: Huh, there are so many varieties out there.
Huh, there are so many varieties out there.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Even over in Dubai, Christmas is super lively, you know!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I heard it's warm over there even this time of year,
so you can meet Santa in short sleeves♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Got you interested?
You curious now?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "You want to spend Christmas together in Dubai someday?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The races in Dubai take place in March. Christmas time is still too early for an overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Then why don't you just move in with me? ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I haven't given up on my dream of living in Dubai either, you know!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It might be tough with everyone, but...
with a new family, it seems doable, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Right?♡
Trainy~?
